question: Who has been appointed as Director (Finance) at the Central Silk Board in January 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PS Girisha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet approved the appointment of PS Girisha (IAS) as Director (Finance) at the Central Silk Board.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **PS Girisha is a 2012-batch Indian Administrative Service officer.**
 
• He belongs to the Andhra Pradesh cadre of the IAS.
 
• The appointment is on deputation basis under the Ministry of Textiles.
 
• Director (Finance), Central Silk Board__ 
 __
 
• Tenure of five years from the date of assuming charge
 
• Director-level position
 
• Non-Central Staffing Scheme post
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Central Silk Board__

 __
 
• Statutory body under the Ministry of Textiles
 
• Headquartered in Bengaluru
 
• Responsible for research, development and promotion of the silk industry in India
 
 
 
• Appointments Committee of the Cabinet__
 __
 
• Approves appointments to senior positions in the Government of India
 
• Chaired by the Prime Minister
 
• Plays a key role in top-level bureaucratic postings
 
 
 
• Non-Central Staffing Scheme Post__
 
 
• Positions outside the Central Staffing Scheme
 
• Appointments made through specific approval mechanisms
 
• Usually involve specialised or autonomous bodies
